title: Tin
body:
Description

Tin ore can spawn in Lightslate, Beigeslate and Darkslate nodes.

Note: Tin will not spawn in Marble and Prismarine nodes as of update 1.67.0.

The raw form of Tin takes on a light gray color that can be mistaken for Iron, but is much closer to Zinc, with less edges on the material.

Putting Tin in a refiner raises the sell price to $22 per stud. Putting that refined Tin through a forge further increases the price to $24 per stud.
